chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Abbas ibn Musa, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from al-Husayn ibn Zayd, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: The private parts become permissible through three: marriage by inheritance, and marriage without inheritance, and marriage by possession of the right hand.

key_terms.الْفَرْجُ: The private parts; refers to sexual intimacy
key_terms.مِلْكِ الْيَمِينِ: Possession of the right hand; referring to slave girls
key_terms.مِيرَاثٌ: Inheritance; referring to the specific case of the Prophet's wives

ai.seo_question: What are the three ways sexual relations become permissible in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) categorizes the three fundamental legal avenues for lawful intimacy into permanent marriage, inheritance of a wife (specifically referencing the unique case of the Prophet Muhammad), and possession of a slave girl (milk al-yamin). This classification underscores the comprehensive nature of Islamic jurisprudence in defining marital and concubine rights, distinguishing between contractual marriage and hereditary or ownership-based relations.
